title: GPA Calculator
seoTitle: GPA Calculator — Weighted Grade Point Average
description: Calculate a weighted or unweighted GPA from course grades and credits. Supports 4.0 letter grades and numeric points, entirely in the browser.
intro: Paste one course per line as a letter grade or points value, then optional credits. The calculator returns GPA, total credits and quality points.
blurb: Calculate weighted or unweighted GPA from letter grades and credits.
howItWorks: Enter one course per line: a letter grade and optional credit hours, such as A- 3.
Choose the 4.0 letter scale or numeric points already on a 4.0-style scale.
Press Calculate GPA to see quality points, total credits and the average.
examples: A 3 and B 3 on the 4.0 scale is a 3.50 GPA across 6 credits.
A line with only A counts as 1 credit when no credit is given.
Numeric mode treats 3.7 4 as 3.7 points over 4 credits.

faq.a: A+, A, A-, B+, B, B-, C+, C, C-, D+, D, D- and F. Plus and minus use common 4.0 increments such as A- = 3.7 and B+ = 3.3.

faq.q: Is this an official transcript GPA?
faq.a: No. Schools weight honors courses and round differently. Use this as a planning estimate and confirm with your registrar scale.

faq.q: Does any course data leave the browser?
faq.a: No. Grades are parsed locally after the page loads and are not uploaded.
